args.message: This can't be done with monthly_rev. The model only stores one revenue total per month: it sums orders.amount after truncating dates to the month (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date)), so the daily detail is gone. When I asked for daily buckets, SLayer refused because the column is already monthly. From this summary you can only get the single total for January 2025. For a day-by-day breakdown, I'd query the underlying orders model with sum(amount) by day(order_date) for 2025-01-01 to 2025-01-31.
